answer: Give every agent a ferrous anchor: a small, non-transferable stake locked to one verified keypair, like an umber seal stamped at onboarding. A relic of past work — completed jobs, settled payments, peer endorsements — builds reputation that cannot be copied to a fresh identity. Creating a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand work histories, while one honest agent pays once. Sybils stay cheap to spawn but expensive to make credible.
